title: LightBurn Job Cut Length Leaderboard
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lightburn:job cut_length_mm=*
| stats sum(cut_length_mm) as total_value, avg(cut_length_mm) as avg_value by material_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks material values by total and average cut length across LightBurn job events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `cut_length_mm` values for each LightBurn job event and review total and average cut length by material.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total cut length.
grandmaExplanation: It neatly which material shows the biggest cut length numbers in your LightBurn job data.
